thread:
maya: heads-up — deploy-bot just blocked the prod push for release-v2.3.1. says provenance checksum mismatch between us-east-1 and eu-west-1 :warning:

deploy-bot: publish failed: provenance_checksum_mismatch: tag=release-v2.3.1, expected_digest=sha256:aa11bb..., seen_digest=sha256:bb22cc... (eu-west-1)

liam: ugh. build pipeline changed the layer ordering again when parallel cache was on. we got a different manifest even though app bits are identical.

maya: confirmed — the build id is the same but sdist ordering differs. i ran skopeo to inspect both registries:

```
# us-east-1
skopeo inspect docker://123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/service:release-v2.3.1
# eu-west-1
skopeo inspect docker://123456789012.dkr.ecr.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/redwood/service:release-v2.3.1
```

maya: manifest digests differ. attestation payload (provenance) hashes the manifest+annotations, so mismatch triggers the guard.

liam: options: (1) retag the eu image with the us digest and push (immutable tagging?); (2) rebuild with deterministic ordering (switch off parallel cache) and re-run CI; (3) override provenance guard for this change window (not ideal).

sre-oncall: we shouldn't override guard for prod. risk too high. prefer retag-if-possible, else rebuild.

maya: trying to retag now — only problem: image tag is immutable per policy in eu account. we can create a new tag: release-v2.3.1-evr1 and re-run promote job.

deploy-bot: promote attempt blocked: target tag conflict with pinned digests in release metadata. Please include explicit digest if promoting non-primary tag.

liam: plan: create new tag release-v2.3.1-eu-respin with correct digest and update release metadata (release-manager sign-off), then run promote pipeline to prod in the next change window (15:00 UTC).

maya: i've kicked off a rebuild with deterministic flags to reproduce locally. if that yields the same digest as us, we'll prefer that and keep tag names consistent. patch CI to disable parallel cache for docker build step: `DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 BUILDKIT_INLINE_CACHE=0 buildctl build --no-cache`

release-manager: please include a brief note in the release channel: why we respin and that prod promotion is delayed ~30m. i'll approve the new tag once we confirm digests.

liam: quick verification command for digests (use authenticated ECR get-manifest):

```
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name redwood/service --image-ids imageTag=release-v2.3.1 --region eu-west-1 --query 'images[0].imageManifest' | jq -r '. | fromjson | .config.digest'
```

maya: update — rebuild with deterministic flags produced sha256:aa11bb... (matches us-east). pushing new tag release-v2.3.1-det and starting promote.

deploy-bot: promote OK queued -> prod (will run during change window).

release-manager: thanks. i'll post note and hold on manual approval until deploy-bot completes. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: leaving monitoring on for 1h after deploy. let me know if we need to roll back.

liam: follow-up: open a small CI ticket to make deterministic build flags the default for release tags, and add a check that build outputs include manifest digest in the artifacts.

maya: created ticket INF-4823 and linked this thread. tagging @devex later for docs update. :white_check_mark:
